answer_text:
Here are some great places where you can order a birthday cake online:

---

### 🎂 1. **Bake Me A Wish** (bakemeawish.com)
Bake Me A Wish! began in 2005 as the premier nationwide service for gourmet birthday cake delivery, with cakes made using only the finest, freshest ingredients by award-winning New York bakeries. They go beyond traditional vanilla and chocolate flavors, offering a wide range of options like Tiramisu, Salted Caramel, Tres Leches, Limoncello, Boston Cream, and Coconut Cream.

---

### 🎂 2. **Goldbelly** (goldbelly.com)
Goldbelly curates a collection of birthday cakes baked at the United States' most famous bakeries, including Carousel Cakes, Daisy Cakes, and We Take the Cake, offering gluten-free, kosher, nut-free, and Paleo birthday cakes shipped nationwide.

---

### 🎂 3. **Milk Bar** (milkbarstore.com)
Milk Bar is best known for its playful and innovative approach to classic desserts. Their cakes have a distinctive naked frosting style with no outer frosting layer on the sides, topped with cake truffles. Their iconic Birthday Cake is a funfetti-inspired vanilla cake layered with frosting and rainbow sprinkles. You can select the delivery date for your order at checkout up to 30 days in advance.

---

### 🎂 4. **Harry & David** (harryanddavid.com)
Their gourmet cakes, specialty desserts, and cheesecakes are handcrafted in their Southern Oregon bakery and delivered nationwide. They offer unique flavors like tiramisu, lava cake, carrot cake, strawberry, and limoncello, along with rotating seasonal specialties.

---

### 🎂 5. **Magnolia Bakery** (magnoliabakery.com)
If you want a good old-fashioned birthday cake, Magnolia is a great option. They take simple, classic flavors like vanilla, chocolate, and carrot cake and make them phenomenal with high-quality ingredients.

---

### 🎂 6. **Whole Foods Market** (wholefoodsmarket.com)
Many Whole Foods Market locations offer a selection of cakes that can be ordered ahead online for easy pickup in store, and select ready-made assortments are also available for delivery.

---

### 🎂 7. **Publix** (publix.com) *(In-store pickup)*
Publix hand-decorates custom cakes in-store to suit your occasion, with a wide selection of themes featuring sports, TV shows, movies, and even Disney Pixar characters. You can also customize a bakery cake with your choice of flavor, filling, and icing.

---

Whether you want a nationwide delivery or a local pickup, these options cover a wide range of styles and budgets! 🎉
